recordSet.description: Station metadata from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) HydroNet station register (https://epawebapp.epa.ie/Hydronet/output/internet/stations/stations.json): station name (`station_name`), water body (`WTO_OBJECT`) and catchment size (`CATCHMENT_SIZE` with its inline km² unit). Elevation is withheld: `station_gauge_datum` is a water-level datum, not a ground elevation. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. Use is subject to the notes, warnings and conditions of the HydroNet disclaimer (https://epawebapp.epa.ie/Hydronet/output/html/disclaimer.html) and FAQ (https://epawebapp.epa.ie/Hydronet/output/html/FAQ.html).
